candidate_sentences.text: Net sales for the year declined by 35 percent to SEK 48,055,007 compared with SEK 74,497,775 in the previous year.

candidate_sentences.text: To address financial pressures and lower its ongoing cost base, the company initiated structural cost reductions projected to decrease annual expenses by approximately 40 percent, corresponding to about SEK 25 million starting in 2026.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, and K6 are PRESENT with adequate coverage in the candidate summary. K4 (product launches and integration plans), K5 (target markets), K7 (outstanding financial instruments details), and K8 (material post-reporting-period events) are MISSING entirely. The summary captures most of the core financial performance and structural changes but omits key strategic product and market information as well as important post-period events, resulting in a Generally yes rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is generally coherent with no material internal contradictions or logical gaps. All statements are logically connected, showing a clear narrative of declining sales, improved gross margin, increased losses, cost reduction initiatives, and improved cash flow. The relationships between declining sales, increased losses, and cost reduction efforts follow logical cause-and-effect patterns. While there is a minor organizational issue in that the cash flow improvement (S10) is mentioned before the detailed breakdown of cash movements and financing activities (S11), this does not constitute a coherence error. There are no self-contradictions, and the summary forms a coherent whole without unnecessary repetition. The arithmetic differences between segment figures and consolidated totals are not contradictions because the candidate does not claim they are exhaustive additive components of the same total.
